body:
We’re finally on the new set! 
On today’s episode, I simply could not resist taking a closer look at the Wall Street Journal’s hit piece on prediction markets. You may or may not be surprised to learn their dramatic takedown hinges entirely on feeling bad for a guy who, to put it mildly, doesn’t appear to make the best decisions in life. 
Think of a friend or relative in your life who makes bad decisions and multiply that by one hundred, then multiply that by eleven thousand, and then you’ll be getting into the ballpark of the type of bad decisions this guy was making. The WSJ, however, thinks prediction markets are to blame for his behavior — I think it’s ridiculous, but I’ll let you be the judge. 
We also weigh in on the new Mandalorian movie and what markets reveal about expectations. 
Check out the full episode below, via my YouTube channel — don’t forget to subscribe if you haven’t already!
